claims.claim: Behaviour tracking is a measurement tool, not a verdict on character. Track opportunities and attempts separately: a missed action when its cue never occurred differs from a missed action despite the cue. Review a small sample cautiously. Self-reported automaticity and adherence are distinct. A seven-day trial can identify barriers, but cannot establish a durable habit or cause-and-effect. Adjust the design rather than punish missed days.
